modelOverview: Introduced in 1989 by Cartier's New York workshop, the Tank Américaine reworked the classic Tank silhouette into a longer, gently curved case that follows the wrist. Offered over the years in Small, Medium/Midsize, Large and XL sizes across steel and precious metals, the Large white-gold model is powered by an in-house automatic movement and remains one of the most recognisable elongated Tanks. Cartier redesigned the line in 2023 with a new automatic calibre, so pre-owned examples from the 1990s-2010s use the earlier automatic movement referenced below.

W2606956.materials: 18k white gold case; fitted to an 18k white gold bracelet or black leather strap with white gold deployant clasp
W2606956.dial: Silvered flinqué/guilloché dial with black Roman numerals, blued-steel sword-shaped hands and a date aperture at 6 o'clock
W2606956.description: A Large-model Tank Américaine in 18k white gold, part of the elongated, curved-case Tank family Cartier introduced in 1989 for the American market. This reference carries the signature silvered guilloché dial, black Roman numerals and blued sword hands over a self-winding automatic movement, with a date window at 6 o'clock. Every piece is sourced and authenticated before sale. Note: this exact reference number could not be independently corroborated on a dealer or Cartier listing; the specifications above are drawn from the closely related, well-documented Large white-gold Tank Américaine references (e.g. W2603256, W2603656, W2609956), which share an identical case, dial and movement.

WSTA0083.materials: Stainless steel case on a semi-matt navy blue alligator leather strap with an interchangeable steel folding buckle; sapphire crystal
WSTA0083.dial: Silvered satin-brushed dial with Roman numerals and blued-steel sword-shaped hands; faceted crown set with a faceted synthetic blue spinel
WSTA0083.description: Note: Cartier lists reference WSTA0083 as the Large-model Tank Américaine in steel rather than a Tank Must. It belongs to the 2023 redesign of the curved, elongated Tank that Cartier first introduced in 1989, pairing a silvered satin-brushed dial and blued sword hands with an automatic movement and a navy alligator strap. Every piece is sourced and authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Silver Dial: Large-model Tank Américaine in stainless steel from the 2023 redesign, with a silvered satin-brushed dial, blued-steel sword hands and spinel-set crown, on a navy blue alligator strap with a steel folding buckle.
